nodes.text: Discovered by Dutch scientists in 2000, serology shows HMPV existed in the Netherlands since 1958. In 2003, BJ Medical College & NIV Pune confirmed it in Indian children. A 2024 Gorakhpur study found 4% of child respiratory cases positive. #HMPV
